verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is a hosted AI inference cloud. Whether such a platform publishes its own source under an open license is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any DeepInfra source code or open license; the public OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI describe the API, and serving open models is not the same as opening the product's own code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
